mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade kitchen lighting in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to upgrade kitchen lighting in Berkeley varies significantly based on the scope of work, types of fixtures chosen, and complexity of installation. Simple fixture replacements might be a few hundred dollars, while a complete redesign with new wiring, recessed lighting, and under-cabinet lights could range from several thousands. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen lighting upgrade costs in Berkeley depend on fixture types and installation complexity, ranging from hundreds to thousands of dollars.
